info.name: PantryCloud API Gateway
info.description: Complete API collection for PantryCloud microservices through the API Gateway. Tokens and IDs are automatically saved to collection variables.

request.description: Check if the API Gateway is healthy and running
Register a new user account. User ID is automatically saved to collection variables.
Login and get access/refresh tokens. Tokens are automatically saved to collection variables.
Refresh the access token using the refresh token. New tokens are automatically saved.
Request a password reset token
Reset password using the token from forgot-password
Verify user email address
Public test endpoint - no authentication required
Secure test endpoint - requires authentication
Get OpenID Connect discovery document
Get JSON Web Key Set for token verification
Get the current user's household. Requires authentication. Household ID is automatically saved.
Create a new household. Requires authentication. Household ID is automatically saved.
Send an invitation to join a household. Requires authentication.
Accept a household invitation using the invitation code. Requires authentication.
Leave the current household. Requires authentication.
Get current user's recipe preferences (dietary profile, excluded ingredients). 404 if none set. Fetch and send in Recipe search/recommend.
Create or update preferences. dietaryProfile: 0=None, 1=Vegetarian, 2=Vegan. User must be in a household.
Get all household members' preferences. For 'recommend for household': aggregate (union excluded, strictest dietary) and send in POST /recipes/recommend.

Create a new pantry item. Requires authentication and household membership.

Unit values:
- 0: Piece
- 1: Kilogram
- 2: Gram
- 3: Liter
- 4: Milliliter
- 5: Pound
- 6: Ounce
- 7: Cup
- 8: Tablespoon
- 9: Teaspoon

Item ID is automatically saved.
Get a specific pantry item by ID. Requires authentication.

Update an existing pantry item. Requires authentication and rowVersion for optimistic concurrency control.

**IMPORTANT**: Before running this request:
1. Run "Get Pantry Item" to get the current item details
2. Copy the "rowVersion" value (base64 string) from the response
3. Paste it into the "rowVersion" field below
4. Then run this request

The rowVersion ensures no one else modified the item since you last read it.
Delete a pantry item. Requires authentication.
List all pantry items with optional filtering and pagination. Requires authentication.

item.name: List Pantry Items - Filter by Category

request.description: List pantry items filtered by category. Requires authentication.
Search pantry items by name. Requires authentication.
Create a new shopping list. Requires authentication and household membership. List names must be unique per household.
List all shopping lists for the household with pagination. Returns summary information including item counts.
Get a specific shopping list with all its items. Requires authentication.
Delete a shopping list. This will also delete all items in the list (cascade delete).

Add a new item to a shopping list.

Unit values:
- 0: Piece
- 1: Gram
- 2: Kilogram
- 3: Liter
- 4: Milliliter

Source values:
- 0: Manual (added by user)
- 1: Pantry (from pantry service)
- 2: Recipe (from recipe service)
Add multiple items to a shopping list at once. Useful for recipe integration.

Update a shopping list item. Requires rowVersion for optimistic concurrency control.

**IMPORTANT**: Before running this request:
1. Run "Get Shopping List" to get the full list with items
2. Copy the "rowVersion" value (base64 string) from the item you want to update
3. Paste it into the "rowVersion" field below
4. Then run this request

The rowVersion ensures no one else modified the item since you last read it.
Toggle the checked status of an item. Automatically tracks who checked it and when.
Delete an item from a shopping list.
Search recipes by ingredients. Optionally include preferences (from Get My Preferences): { "ingredients": [...], "preferences": { "dietaryProfile": "Vegetarian", "excludedIngredients": ["nuts"] } }.
Search with preference filter. Fetch preferences from GET /households/me/preferences, then send here. dietaryProfile: None|Vegetarian|Vegan.
Recommend recipes. Fetch GET /households/me/members/preferences, aggregate (union excluded, strictest dietary), then send here. ingredientHints optional; limit 1–100.
Get a specific recipe by ID. Requires authentication. Recipe ID is automatically saved when running Search Recipes or when using a known ID.
Seed sample recipes into the database. Only available in Development environment. Requires authentication.
